bundle.shortDescription: Mod manager for Zenless Zone Zero (ZZMI / XXMI)
bundle.longDescription: ZZMM installs, enables, and previews Zenless Zone Zero mods for the ZZMI / XXMI (3DMigoto) loader. It browses GameBanana, installs archives, checks updates, and edits mod INI hotkeys with backups.
